comment: Turns product reviews on or off on the storefront.
modal: Controls whether the **Product Reviews** feature is available on the storefront, letting shoppers read and submit reviews. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether visitors who aren't logged in can submit product reviews.
modal: When **Yes**, guests who are not signed-in customers can write product reviews; when **No**, only registered customers can. Applies only when **Product Reviews** is enabled. Can differ per website.
